definitions.ask: Refuse a line whose @file+id markers sit at both edges, instead of keeping the trailing one as note text?
definitions.why: Someone who names targets at both edges means all of them; silently misfiling is worse

choices.label: `@a+x note @b+y` fails with a teaching error to put every target in one run
Today's leading-wins rule stays; `@b+y` is written into the note under ^x
